name: Terrestrial Circle Sorcery

cost.raw: 1 Willpower (per spell; each spell also has an Essence cost)

description: Lets the character learn and cast spells of the Terrestrial (First) Circle. Each spell also has its own Essence cost, listed in the spell. Cannot be placed in a Combo.

name: Celestial Circle Sorcery

cost.raw: 1 Willpower (per spell; each spell also has an Essence cost)

description: Lets the character learn and cast spells of the Celestial (Second) Circle, the magic of the Celestial Exalted. Cannot be placed in a Combo.

name: Solar Circle Sorcery

cost.raw: 3 Willpower (per spell; each spell also has an Essence cost)

description: Lets the character learn and cast spells of the Solar (Third) Circle, the most powerful sorcery, available only to the Solar Exalted. Cannot be placed in a Combo.

name: Shadowlands Circle Necromancy
description: The necromancy of the First Circle, binding the dark energies of the Underworld — potent but limited in scope. Invoking this Charm enables the character to cast a single Shadowlands Circle Necromancy spell; the spell's own Essence cost (listed in its description) must also be paid. Shadowlands Circle Necromancy can never be part of a Combo. (Solars may learn Shadowlands and Labyrinth Circle Necromancy, but never the Void Circle.)

name: Labyrinth Circle Necromancy
description: The necromancy of the Second Circle — the stuff of nightmares and dreams best left to dead gods, offering great and terrible power. Enables the character to cast a single Labyrinth Circle Necromancy spell; the spell's own Essence cost must also be paid. Labyrinth Circle Necromancy can never be part of a Combo.

name: Spirit-Detecting Glance
description: Perceives unmanifested spirits, gods, ghosts, and demons that would otherwise be invisible.

name: Spirit-Cutting Attack
description: Lets the character's attacks strike and harm dematerialized spirits.

name: Ghost-Eating Technique
description: Devours a slain ghost's Essence, permanently destroying it and feeding the character's pools.

name: Spirit-Repelling Diagram
description: Inscribes a diagram that bars spirits from an area or holds a bound spirit at bay.

name: All-Encompassing Sorcerer's Sight
description: Perceives the flow of Essence in the world, identifying enchantments, Manses, and demesnes.
